name: Burgundians
alt: Burgundian tribes before the Rhine kingdom

successors.name: Kingdom of the Burgundians
successors.text: the Rhine settlement near Worms with which Cliopatria's Burgundian Kingdom row opens in 414

ledger.x: 154: Ptolemy places the Burgundians between the Oder and the Vistula.
409: the Burgundians cross the Rhine and leave the Main.
409: Burgundians are among the peoples who have entered Roman Gaul.
413: the Burgundians receive land in Gaul near the Rhine as foederati.
413: the Burgundians become the federate Kingdom of the Burgundians.

wars.name: Probus's campaign against the Burgundi and Vandals
wars.outcome: Zosimus says Probus defeated the Burgundi and Vandals near a river (the Lech, if the page's guess is right).

wars.name: Maximian's defence of Gaul against the Burgundiones and Alemanni
wars.outcome: The Burgundiones and Alemanni attacked Gaul and were defeated by Maximian (reported in a panegyric of 289).

wars.name: Gothic defeat of the Burgundians (panegyric of 291)
wars.outcome: The Goths 'utterly destroyed' the Burgundians in Maximian's reign; the Burgundians also took Alemanni farmland.

wars.name: Valentinian's Alemannic campaign with Burgundian allies
wars.outcome: Valentinian enlisted the Burgundians against the Alemanni and their king Macrianus; Ammianus says they 'knew that they are descendants of the Romans from ancient times'.

certainty.note: Tribal territory known from Ptolemy, a few panegyrics and the Laterculus Veronensis; the Rhine settlement near Worms is a traditional site, not a surveyed one.
